definitions.short: properly, pallor , i.e. hence, the yellowish green of young and sickly vegetation; concretely, verdure , i.e. grass or vegetation
definitions.full: H3418. yereq יֶ֫רֶק noun masculine Isa 15:6 green, greenness (on in gardens, see Nö ZMG 1876, 777 Löw p. 236 f. ) — absolute Exod 10:15 ; Isa 15:6 ; construct Gen 1:30 3 t.; — עֵשֶׂב יֶרֶק 1:30 ; 9:3 (both P); דֶּשֶׁא יֶרֶק Psa 37:2 הַשָּׂדֶה יֶרֶק Num 22:4 (E) = green thing, grass ; alone Exod 10:15 (J) green thing , including עֵץ and עֵשֶׂב , Isa 15:6 .
definitions.rootNote: from 3417 (in the sense of vacuity of color);

occurrences.englishText: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left. There remained nothing green, either tree or herb of the field, through all the land of Egypt.
Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.”
For they shall soon be cut down like the grass,
For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.
